SELECT 
    d.MaHoaDon AS order_id,
    CAST(d.NgayLap AS DATE) AS order_date,
    d.MaKhachHang AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(k.TenGoi, NULL) AS customer_name,
    d.TongThanhToan AS total_due,
    (d.TinhTrang = 'cancelled' OR d._huy = true) AS is_cancelled,
    (d.PhuongThucTT = 'cod' OR d.TinhTrang IN ('cancelled', 'returned') OR d._huy = true OR d._tra = true) AS no_debt,
    (d.PhuongThucTT = 'debt') AS is_credit
FROM "don_hang" d
LEFT JOIN "khach_hang" k ON d.MaKhachHang = k.MaKhachHang
WHERE d.IDCuaHang = 'dev_006'

SELECT 
    t.MaHoaDon AS order_id,
    CAST(t.NgayGioThu AS DATE) AS pay_date,
    t.SoTienThu AS amount
FROM "thanh_toan" t
WHERE t.IDCuaHang = 'dev_006'
